unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Listen attentively to spoken language and show understanding by joining in and responding.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Explore patterns and sounds through songs and rhymes and link spelling, sound and meaning.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Hold conversations, ask and answer questions, give opinions, respond to others and ask for clarification (modern languages).

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Speak in sentences using familiar vocabulary, phrases and basic structures.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Use accurate pronunciation and intonation when reading aloud or using familiar words (modern languages).

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Present ideas and information orally to different audiences (modern languages).

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Read carefully and show understanding of words, phrases and simple writing.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Appreciate stories, songs, poems and rhymes in the language.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Widen vocabulary and work out new words in familiar texts, including using a dictionary.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Write phrases from memory and adapt them into new sentences to express ideas clearly.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Describe people, places, things and actions orally (modern languages) and in writing.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Understand basic grammar, including masculine, feminine and neuter forms and conjugating common verbs where relevant.

unit: Languages programme of study: foreign language
outcome: Notice key features and patterns of the language, use them to build sentences, and compare them with English.
